subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation automation be supported through the existing plugin `session_end` lifecycle path with a narrow missing SDK seam, or through a new core cron event schedule?
rationale: Current main has adjacent lifecycle hooks and cron scheduling primitives but not the requested subscription surface, and the permanent shape affects public cron config, plugin API boundaries, and sensitive archived-session metadata.

options.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
options.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the smallest plugin-facing scheduling/event capability needed for safe external automation.

options.title: Add core cron lifecycle schedules
options.body: Define `schedule.kind: event` for session archive/rotation with scoped payloads, permissions, persistence, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Decline new core surface
options.body: Document the current plugin-hook workaround and keep self-improving memory workflows outside core cron unless a narrower missing API is proven.

recommendation.title: Use plugin lifecycle plus SDK seam
recommendation.body: Bless `session_end` as the session-boundary signal and add only the smallest plugin-facing scheduling/event capability needed for safe external automation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily a plugin/core API-boundary choice, and this person is the strongest routing signal from current plugin/hook history.
